demo.subtitle: A zero-dependency QR Code encoder with built-in SVG / Canvas / PNG / Terminal renderers, plus an online QR tool with history.

playground.title: Live Playground
playground.description: Edit content and options, rendered instantly on the right

zeroDep.title: Zero runtime dependencies
zeroDep.description: Encoding and SVG / Canvas / PNG rendering are pure algorithms with no runtime dependencies. Works in browsers, Node.js, WeChat Mini Programs and more.

renderers.title: Four renderers
renderers.description: SVG (vector), Canvas (cross-platform bitmap), PNG (pure-algorithm Uint8Array) and Terminal output, ready out of the box.

ecc.title: Adjustable error correction
ecc.description: Supports L / M / Q / H error correction levels with a configurable minimum version. Encoding is fully deterministic for identical parameters.

typescript.title: Written in TypeScript
typescript.description: Complete type definitions and subpath exports (encoder / renderers), tree-shaking friendly, with an IIFE build for script tags.
